metadata.description: ['Forever 21 Contemporary Crafted with the comfy features the five pocket construction, zip fly, and slight stretch and flattering fit you love, these skinny jeans will mesh with most of the tops in your wardrobe (and make you look good, too!). Those details are enough to make this pair a must have, but takes them from liked to loved is their classic light wash and distressed knees (a rough around the edges touch lending a major cool factor). ', 'Lightweight, woven', '99% cotton, 1% spandex', '29" inseam, 28.5" waist, 8.25" rise', 'Measured from Size 25', 'Machine wash cold', 'Made in China']
metadata.text: Forever 21 Contemporary Crafted with the comfy features the five pocket construction, zip fly, and slight stretch and flattering fit you love, these skinny jeans will mesh with most of the tops in your wardrobe (and make you look good, too!). Those details are enough to make this pair a must have, but takes them from liked to loved is their classic light wash and distressed knees (a rough around the edges touch lending a major cool factor). || Lightweight, woven || 99% cotton, 1% spandex || 29" inseam, 28.5" waist, 8.25" rise || Measured from Size 25 || Machine wash cold
